## Work item (verbatim)
GOAL: Demonstrate approved knowledge reaching the prepared worker: run the Control Room row-content-fit delivery workflow on merged main with the dense store reachable from the cell network, and capture the evidence block the worker receives.
The Control Room's run rows clip their own values mid-token at 1024x768 and
390x844, with no way to read them (no title/aria-label, no scrollable region,
body { overflow-y: hidden }). Fix the run-row content fit:
- Every run-row value (session id, terminal target, command/spec, model x attempt,
  phase n/t, lifecycle, claim/evidence, commit, cost provenance, eligibility,
  receipt) must be READABLE at 1440x900, 1024x768, and 390x844: let cells wrap,
  restructure the row into labelled lines, and/or drop only the lowest-signal
  fields — never cut a value mid-token ("unk…", "missin…", "promotab…").
- If a value must be shortened, give it an accessible full-text path (title +
  a keyboard-reachable disclosure) — a bare clipped string is not acceptable.
- No horizontal overflow at any of the three viewports; the page's scroll
  contract stays honored (vertical scrolling where content exceeds the viewport).
- Work only in apps/control_room/static/ (plus tests only if a selector pin needs
  updating). Do not add panels/lenses/metrics, do not change the IA, do not derive
  consequential values client-side; unmeasured values stay labelled unknowns.
- Run the verification commands in context.verification (the render gate's
  --check-fixtures must PASS; the focused tests must stay green) and commit.


SPEC CONTEXT (the workflow's declared domain context — constraints, canonical sources, and verification contract; follow it):
